item.title: GitOps (Part 1): HashiCorp Vault for Zero Trust Secrets Management
item.author: xuanphuc.a1gv@gmail.com (Felix Hoang)
item.description: In the last two parts of the On-Premise 101 series, I showed you how to provision and bootstrap a full Kubernetes cluster. Now, I’m tearing part of it down and rebuilding the entire workflow. Why? The project’s goal was always automation, but I hit a wall. The manual steps to set up that automation - like managing secrets and SSH keys - became a huge liability.
